title: Relay C: The Silent Party (bug hunt)
body:
Goal: build a broken party show exactly as shown, then find and fix its two bugs. Tool: Scratch app (offline). Work as a relay team.

What it should do

After the green flag, the Ghost hides. When you press space, the cat says "Party time!", then the Ghost appears, does a slow spinning dance you can really watch (one full turn, about 2 seconds) and says "Woo!".

Build steps

  1. Start a new project. Keep the cat. Add the Ghost sprite.
  2. Make two messages: in a broadcast block, click the dropdown, choose New message, type party. Make another called dance.
  3. Build the scripts below exactly as written, bugs and all.
  4. Click the green flag, then press space. Compare with "What it should do".
  5. Use the four detective steps. Fix one thing at a time and test after each change.
  6. Write both bugs and fixes on your relay baton (workbook, Exercise 6.3).

The scripts in words (with two bugs)

Cat:

  • when space key pressed
  • say "Party time!" for 2 seconds
  • broadcast party

Ghost, two scripts:

  1. when green flag clicked
    • hide
  2. when I receive dance
    • show
    • repeat 10:
      • turn right 36 degrees
      • next costume
    • say "Woo!" for 2 seconds

Expected behavior

After your fixes: the Ghost is hidden after the green flag. Pressing space makes the cat say "Party time!"; then the Ghost appears, spins once slowly (about 2 seconds) while changing costume, and says "Woo!".

Checklist

hints.label: Hint 1
hints.title: Where to look
hints.html: Press the green flag, then space. Does the Ghost ever show up? Then press space again and watch the dance very closely. Does it look slow, like it should?

hints.label: Hint 2
hints.title: Try this
hints.html: For bug one, compare the broadcast block in the cat with the when I receive block in the Ghost, in the Events category. For bug two, the loop runs so fast that your eyes cannot follow it. Computers need to be told to slow down.

hints.label: Hint 3
hints.title: Almost there
hints.html: Click both message dropdowns and read the names side by side. Do they match? For the dance, look in the Control category for a block that makes a script pause. Ten turns in about 2 seconds means each turn gets a small slice of time. Where in the loop should the pause go?
